before_dev_outputs: For candidate surface a let t,b,r,p be its best QA span-vs-null margin in target, base, single-edit rollback, and addback, floored at -10. Let clip truncate to [-6,6]. Whole and rollback features add 0.5*clip(t-b) and 0.5*clip(t-r) to the current span logit. The symmetric feature adds 0.5*(clip(min(t-r,p-b))+min(0,clip(p-t))). Within a document the ordinary direct winner remains an option with zero bonus. The strongest four distinct answer spans overlapping each of two QA-relevant edit regions are eligible. Penalize document rank by ln(1+rank). The changed-only baseline uses the strongest any-overlap span; a document with no insert/replace region falls back to its unmodified reader.
